WITH store_sales_1998 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d.d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        's' AS sale_type
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address,
        d.d_year
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) > 0
),
store_sales_1999 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d.d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        's' AS sale_type
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998 + 1
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address,
        d.d_year
),
web_sales_1998 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d.d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        'w' AS sale_type
    FROM customer c
    JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address,
        d.d_year
    HAVING SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) > 0
),
web_sales_1999 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d.d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        'w' AS sale_type
    FROM customer c
    JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998 + 1
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address,
        d.d_year
),
store_ratios AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        s99.customer_id,
        s99.customer_first_name,
        s99.customer_last_name,
        s99.customer_email_address,
        CASE WHEN s98.year_total > 0 THEN s99.year_total / s98.year_total ELSE 0.0 END AS store_growth_ratio,
        s98.sale_type AS sale_type
    FROM store_sales_1998 s98
    JOIN store_sales_1999 s99 ON s98.customer_id = s99.customer_id
    WHERE s98.sale_type = 's'
      AND s99.sale_type = 's'
      AND s98.dyear = 1998
      AND s99.dyear = 1998 + 1
      AND s98.year_total > 0
),
web_ratios AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        w99.customer_id,
        w99.customer_first_name,
        w99.customer_last_name,
        w99.customer_email_address,
        CASE WHEN w98.year_total > 0 THEN w99.year_total / w98.year_total ELSE 0.0 END AS web_growth_ratio,
        w98.sale_type AS sale_type
    FROM web_sales_1998 w98
    JOIN web_sales_1999 w99 ON w98.customer_id = w99.customer_id
    WHERE w98.sale_type = 'w'
      AND w99.sale_type = 'w'
      AND w98.dyear = 1998
      AND w99.dyear = 1998 + 1
      AND w98.year_total > 0
)
SELECT
    sr.customer_id,
    sr.customer_first_name,
    sr.customer_last_name,
    sr.customer_email_address
FROM store_ratios sr
JOIN web_ratios wr ON sr.customer_id = wr.customer_id
WHERE sr.sale_type = 's'
  AND wr.sale_type = 'w'
  AND wr.web_growth_ratio > sr.store_growth_ratio
ORDER BY
    sr.customer_id,
    sr.customer_first_name,
    sr.customer_last_name,
    sr.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
